domain: Core hardware telemetry / DataVault / crash blackbox

findings.fact: HardwareThermalTelemetryEntry was 64 bytes while DumpBlackBoxCold wrote a 24-byte header stride and a 24-byte per-entry buffer.
findings.risk: Postmortem dump readers consume a different ABI than the native blackbox ring stores.

findings.fact: TryResolveThermalSeverity and TryResolveThermalBlackBox could acquire or allocate mutable DataVault views.
findings.risk: Read/resolve helper names hid native mutation and allocation routes.

findings.fact: DataVault replacement did not reopen thermal native state while the service was active.
findings.risk: The first post-rebind tick could become the implicit allocation route.

changes: Added HardwareThermalTelemetryEntryBytes=64 and used it for struct size, dump header stride, and dump entry buffer.
Changed DumpBlackBoxCold to use TryReadThermalBlackBox read-only view.
Changed severity and blackbox writes to use TryAcquireWriteLock and ReleaseWriteLock in finally.
Removed mutating TryResolveThermalSeverity and TryResolveThermalBlackBox helpers.
Reopened thermal native state on active DataVault service replacement.
